LSI overcomes this by deriving a continuous-time Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) objective, allowing for the end-to-end optimization of an encoder, a decoder, and a latent SI model. This approach enables the transformation of an arbitrary prior distribution into the encoder-defined aggregated posterior, aligning data representations with a high-fidelity generative process.
